text: Bear Twist (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Rockrending Gauntlets. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Takedown.

Bait Battle is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by completing the mission Document of Worth. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Expeditionist" and "Justice-Loving Soul" Field Skills. Completing this mission unlocks the Merc Mission Everyone Loves Floren.

Avenger is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases all damage dealt by up to 150% when at least one party member is incapacitated. It is equivalent in effect to the Dark Orb, Eraser Orb and Bloody Orb accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
Bana's Revenge is a quest in . It can be received from Niranira in the Chairman's Room of the Argentum Trade Guild.
The Band of Assassins is an Info Item in . It is received after completing the Merc Mission Unjust Organization. It must be obtained in order to complete the quest Failure and Success.
|-|XC2= |-|NS2= Bana the Schemer (Japanese: , Bān no Inbō, Bana's Scheme) is a Main Story Quest in . It can be received from Mòrag at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium.
* Basics of Tiger! Tiger! 1 * Basics of Tiger! Tiger! 2 * Basics of Tiger! Tiger! 3 These items can be found at Tora's House.
The Barrels' Destination is an Info Item in . It is obtained during the penultimate objective of Lila's Location by examining the barrels with level 3 "Nopon Mastery".

Azgall is an NPC in . He is a dead Tantalese whose body can be found lying at the Little Banerro Ruins on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. From his dead body, the Quest Glory from the Past can be received with the Dead Man's Message.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Beatific Medals (Japanese: , Seiō no Kunshō) are DLC accessories in . They restore up to 6.5% of the wearer's maximum HP every time they successfully cancel an Auto-Attack with an Art. They are the upgraded version of the Chivalric Medal, Military Medal and Round Table Medal accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

Azzale Blants (Japanese: , Azarea Barando) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Blant family fought at level 30 during the first wave of the Challenge Battle Bewitching Dance. This enemy drops no items.

The Baythe Eluca (Japanese: , Baito Erūka) is a Challenge Battle Enemy in . It is a member of the Eluca family that is fought at level 60 during the Challenge Battle Temperantian Standoff. This enemy drops no items.

Beachhead Krabbles (Japanese: , Bīchimain Kuraibu) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family that are fought at level 50 during the first wave of the Challenge Battle Panic at the Seaside. This enemy drops no items.

Beachhead Urchons (Japanese: , Bīchimain Unin) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Urchon family that are fought at level 50 during the first wave of the Challenge Battle Panic at the Seaside. This enemy drops no items.

Bandette Pippitos (Japanese: , Bandetto Pipitto) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family that are fought at level 100 during the Challenge Battle Chickenheart Challenge. This enemy drops no items.

The Battle Observer is an NPC in . He is added in the version 1.5.0 update. He can be found at the Garfont Rear Gate in the Kingdom of Uraya. Talking to him will allow the player to view the Unique Monster Subjugation Report. The Battle Observer offers no quests or merc missions.
Beam Thrust (Japanese: , Bīmusurasuto) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using the Monado. This art recycles Nia's Hammerhead.
Avian Spin (Japanese: , Bādosupin, Lit. "Bird Spin") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when wielding Knives. This art recycles Nia's Jaguar Slash.

Barhanen is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese who can be found at the Soprac Old Market in the Kingdom of Tantal. He gives the DLC quest Artisanal Accessories upon installing the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass, and runs the DLC Shop So-Called Best Artisan.

Beach Date Pandoria (Japanese: ) is a DLC Aux Core in . It reduces the damage taken from field hazards such as poisoned pools of water and fire by 35%. It also changes Pandoria's appearance when she equips the core, granting her a two piece teal swimsuit. It can be purchased at the DLC shop Noponstone Exchange for 45 Flawless Noponstones in the Land of Challenge obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. The DLC Aux Cores Pro Swimmer Pyra, Radiant Beach Mythra and Water Lily Brighid have the same effect. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variant Swim Lesson Poppi α grants Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ an eq
Bat Tango (Japanese: , Battodansu, Lit. "Bat Dance") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when wielding Dual Swords.
Barmy Tale of Barney is a quest in . It can be received from Isabella at Yanchik Harbor in the Kingdom of Torna.

Bathein (Japanese: , Bazuain) is an NPC in . He is the finest sniper in the Ardainian army, and can be found on the Ardainian flagship moored at Lascham Cove on Gormott. He gives the quest The Ardainian Gunman, and his Community is gained upon its completion. The Bathein Watchtower is named after him.

Azzarn is an NPC in . He is an Urayan traveling performer who can be found at the Sachsum Gardens in Auresco of the Kingdom of Torna, performing with Leo. He recruits Rikoko into their group during The Bard Factor, and his Community is gained upon completion of Proof of Love.
Bat Hinges are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be obtained from Old Machine Collection Points in Gormott, including one beside the wooden building at Lascham Cove.
Balaur, Dark Zone #1 (Japanese: , Daiichi Kinku Baraūru) is a landmark in . It is a short path located in the Tornan Titan Interior, beyond the Hall of Worship. The Crooked Tower is here.
Banishment (Japanese: , Banisshu, Lit. "Banish") is one of Hugo's Rear Guard Arts in .
Baric Blast (Japanese: ) is one of Haze's Rear Guard Arts in .
Batwing Charms are Charm items in . They can be created by Lora at Campsites.
Barbed Tomatoes are Vegetable collectible items in . They can be found in Gormott, in particular between Torigoth Village and Torigoth Cemetery as well as far north of Titan's Roar.
Bargain Sunglasses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group.
Bargain Sport Glasses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
Bargain Round Sunglasses are Casual Wear head armor in and . They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group.

Awarth Scorpoxes (Japanese: , Auārusu Sukopio) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Scorpox family and can be found at level 27 - 29 at the Dannagh Desert in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. This enemy has an enhancement which boosts Break resistance by 30%.

Avero Tirkin (Japanese: , Abeo Tākin) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family and can be found at level 20 - 22 on Wrackham Moor and in the Tirkin Cliff Colony in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna.
* Bafalgar Tomb * The Book of Bafalgar * The Blood of Bafalgar * The Path of Bafalgar * The Coffin of Bafalgar * The Gratitude of Bafalgar

Basic Missions (Japanese: , Simple Quest) are a type of mission in . They are received at the Mission Control board on the BLADE Concourse, have simple objectives, and do not count towards survey completion. There are a total of 366 Basic Missions. They are divided into three types: * Social missions simply require the party to talk to specific NPCs. Some of these lead to a specific Story, Affinity, or Normal Mission. * Gathering missions require the party to collect a number of a specific material or collectible, or to find a specific important item. * Bounty missions require the party to hunt a number of a given enemy. Basic Missions are unlocked as the player's BLADE Level increases only
Azurda SOS is a quest in . It can be received from Tarath near the Auresco, Rear Gate in the Kingdom of Torna.

The Ballistaurs are a type of bipedal small Titans fought in . They are grey with fairly elongated faces, and taller than any humanoid. Bronze armor is seen on their heads, arms, shoulders and torso. They have been weaponized by Ardainian Soldiers, machine guns are found under their arms, and they have what appears to be a missile on their backs. Ballistaurs are only found in Temperantia and the Land of Challenge, they are level 130, and have the name Kurodil.

The Barouh Ruins Cave (Japanese: , Baruu Iseki Dōkutsu) is a location in . It is a small cave located on the Bionis' Shoulder on the upper path from Barouh Plaza, below Pillar Knoll, containing an earth ether deposit.
Bartholomew is a NPC in . He is a Homs who can be found at Heroes' Rest on the Bionis' Shoulder.

Battle!! is a track from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track seventeen of disc one on the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track seventeen of disc six from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song is heard whenever the party engages a regular enemy in battle in areas up until the Cliffs of Morytha: Argentum Trade Guild, Gormott Province, Kingdom of Uraya, Empire of Mor Ardain, Temperantia, Indoline Praetorium, Kingdom of Tantal, Leftherian Archipelago, and Spirit Crucible Elpys. This song is reused in . It plays during the third fight against the Nopon Eater during The Hope of Noponkind, and during the Challenge Battle The Two Saviors. Additionally, Battle!! plays
Beanstalk Amulets are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can be purchased from various Shops for 7,200 G. They can only be worn by Kino.
Beanstalk Anklets are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can be purchased from various Shops for 10,800 G. They can only be worn by Kino.
Beanstalk Hair Ties are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can be purchased from various Shops. They can only be worn by Kino.
Beanstalk Knapsacks are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can be purchased from various Shops for 13,500 G. They can only be worn by Kino.
Beanstalk Vests are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can be purchased from various Shops for 16,200 G. They can only be worn by Kino.
Bana's Theme is an Event Track in , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track five of disc one from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack. The song plays in many cutscenes involving Chairman Bana.
Azure Striker, Form the Third: Soulfire (Japanese: , Sōenken San no Kata Shiranui), abbreviated Azure III: Soulfire, is Brighid's Level IV Blade Special in .
Beary-Go-Round is Ursula's Level III Blade Special in . Beary-Go-Round is also Ursula's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Ball Lightning is Vess's Level II Blade Special in . Ball Lightning is also Vess's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .

Avis (Japanese: , Awisu) are Minor Enemies in . They are Agnian Levnises, and can be found at level 29-30 in the Millick Meadows, level 7-34 in Alfeto Valley, and level 47 in Erythia Sea and Captocorn Peak. Avis can also be found at level 50-51 on the Ascension Grounds of Agnus Castle before defeating the Queen of Agnus during Chapter 6. These Avis will not target the party, regardless of level.

Auxilias (Japanese: , Aujiriasu) are minor enemies in . They are Kevesi Levnises, and can be found at level 36-37 at the Ether Mine on the Syra Hovering Reefs, nearby Ambusher Tirion. They are visually similar to Speculatos and Velites, but have different hand augments that are more suited to ether collection than combat.

Avis Achates are enemies in . They are Agnian Levnises, and can be found at level 6 in Alfeto Valley, as well as throughout the story in various cutscenes, such as various war scenes between Agnus and Keves.
Avenging Eagle (Japanese: , Arawashi) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Tactician class.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Beastfang Necklaces are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Wilderness Caravan. The legendary variant can be acquired by defeating Lapdog Veece. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Watchful Valencia.

The Battlescar Ferronis Hulk (Japanese: , Kosenjō-ato no Kuchita Tetsukyoshin) is a Rest Spot in . It is located at Rottswoe Battlescar on Everblight Plain. In order to use this Ferronis Hulk, the Quest The Battlescar Hulk must be completed, and requires 30 Ether Cylinders to reboot. The Battlescar Caravan is located here.
Bannis Path (Japanese: , Banisu no Komichi) is a Landmark in . It is located at the Great Sword's Base in the Cadensia Region.
Barren Knoll (Japanese: , Kyomu no Oka) is a Location in . It is located in the Eagus Wilderness in the Fornis Region.

Baldotas Atoll (Japanese: , Barudotasu Kanshō) is a Location in . It is located in Erythia Sea in the Cadensia Region. It is the remains of a Leftherian Titan, likely the Baldotas Isle Titan. The Atoll Ferronis Hulk is located here.
Beaknib Quills are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Balm Balsas are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced by the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Beaconstones are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be produced from the Clifftop Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Bafflestripe Gourds are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Lambda Caravan, or produced from the Clifftop Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Baythe Vangs are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Vang family, and can be found at level 14-17 in the Eagus Wilderness in the Fornis Region.
Baccura Caterpiles are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 41-42 in Torus Hollow in Elaice Highway and at level 45-46 at the Great Sword's Base.
Bard Ignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 41-42 on Elaice Highway.
Bard Tirkins are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 18-20 at the Tirkin Headquarters on Ribbi Flats.
Bardlord Tirkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 21-22 in Ribbi Flats and level 47 on the Urayan Trail.
Baruka Fliers are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Flier family, and can be found at level 31-35 in High Maktha Wildwood in the Pentelas Region.
Baby Corals are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Babybubble Berries are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Mu Caravan, or produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator or the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Avee Skwarors are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Skwaror family, and can be found at level 31-36 in High Maktha Wildwood.
Baccura Elucas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Eluca family, and can be found at level 41-43 on Elaice Highway and at the Great Sword's Base.
Bard Merignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 46-48 & 72 in Erythia Sea.
Basreek Feris are Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Feris family, and two are fought at level 47 in the Perimeter Woodland of Li Garte Prison Camp during Second Day of Prison.
Ayase (Japanese: ) is a NPC in . Ayase is from Colony Mu. She is an Agnian human with Urayan traits.
The Battlescar Caravan is a shop in . It is located at the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk in Everblight Plain after completing The Battlescar Hulk.
The Beat-Up Shoe is a Key Item in . It is a battered shoe that somebody lost. The party finds it on Migrow's Rosary during To Face Forward, giving the shoe to Lotus.
Baruka Skeeters are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found at level 25-30 on Melnath's Shoulder.
Baruka Wisps are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Wisp family, and can be found at level 23-24 in Dannagh Desert at night.

The Aviga Volff is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Volff family that is fought alongside five Avee Volffs at level 49 near Melnath's Pass, Lower on Melnath's Shoulder during Extracurricular Lesson if the party doesn't investigate what Kyrie notices.
Avee Volffs are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and are fought at level 48 on Melnath's Shoulder during Extracurricular Lesson.
Avee Rhoguls are four Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family, and are fought at level 48 on Melnath's Shoulder during Extracurricular Lesson.

The Aviga Rhogul is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Rhogul family, and is fought at level 50 alongside four Avee Rhoguls at Loch Ciel on Melnath's Shoulder during Extracurricular Lesson.
Baked Spongy Spuds are Meal items in . They can only be eaten at the Colony 9 Canteen after completing Zeon's Ascension Quest Reasons to Evolve.
Autumn Rain (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Troubadour class.
Barbarous Rage (Japanese: , Barubarosu Reiji) is a Chain Art in . It is Triton's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.
Avalanche Onslaught (Japanese: , Reido Abaranchi) is a Chain Art in . It is Ghondor's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.

Battle Pheromone is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Gracious Titania while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Beast Howl (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Lapdog Veece while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.
Backspin Punch (Japanese: , Bakkusupin'nakkuru, Lit. "Backspin Knuckle") is one of Matthew's arts in .
The Battlefield Camp (Japanese: , Senjō-ato no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in , located by the Colony 5 Wreckage and the Colony Gamma Wreckage in Vermilion Woods.
Baggy Swedes are Vegetable Collectibles in . They can be found in Yesterdale.

Babalulu is a Nopon NPC in . His Community is gained when talking to him after completing The Very Lost Nopon.
Baby Rhoguls are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family, and can be found at level 35 in Vermilion Woods after hatching from Rhogul Eggs.
Baby Aspars are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Aspar family, and can be found at level 15 on the Aurora Shelf after hatching from Aspar Eggs.

Battle in the Skies Above is a track from , composed by ACE. It is track thirteen of disc five on the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track thirteen of disc ten on the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This music is heard whenever the party engages an enemy in battle in the First Low Orbit Station. This track also plays when battling the Vaido Sovereign during Limits of Awareness and the Blade Bots during Artificial Intelligence. In , this song plays when battling Malos's Gargoyles.

Awakened DNA is a track from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track twenty-two of disc one from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track twenty-two of disc six from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the awakening cutscenes for Rare Blades.

Battle on the Seas is a track from , composed by Manami Kiyota. It is track six of disc six on the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track six of disc seventeen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song is heard whenever the party engages an aquatic enemy in battle in the water of Erythia Sea. This song also plays when Triton attacks Lanz during Doing It My Way.

Battlefield - The Scramble for Life is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track two of disc one from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track two of disc twelve from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments: * In the opening cutscene during the battle between Colony 9 and Colony Sigma. * As the area theme for the Syra Hovering Reefs during A Deep-Seated Scar from when the party arrives at the Syra Hovering Reefs until when the party reaches Colony 11.
Bahamut Wave is one of Ga Jiarg's two Signature Arts in . Cross can learn it by completing Lionhearted.
The Barking Simius are two Main Bosses in . They are members of the Simius family that are fought at level 55 in the Canopied Nightwood in Noctilum during Chapter 13 (Act 2).
Barulu is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found at the Ayvill Shopping District in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is spoken to during the quest The Ties That Bind.

The Bandits are three quest-exclusive enemies in . They are a members of a group of Gormotti bandits that are known as the "Brothers of Steel". They are fought twice during The Home of the Soul at level 39, once at Loska's Gap and again the Old Quarry in the Kingdom of Uraya, with them being fought alongside the Bandit Chief, their leader, during the latter encounter.

The Bandit Chief is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . He is the leader of a group of Gormotti bandits known as the "Brothers of Steel", and is fought at level 40 at the Old Quarry in the Kingdom of Uraya during The Home of the Soul alongside three Bandits.

Battle Probes are types of Data Probes in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Throughout the region in which they are installed, they grant Battle Effects to the party. However, these effects are capped at rank V.
Balance Rock BC (Japanese: , Baransu Rokku BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp operated by the Interceptors, located in Oblivia.

Bastion Glennar (Japanese: , Fōto Gurennā) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Prone Ganglion and the leader of the Lotus Keep Building Site in Noctilum where he is fought at level 34 during The Art of War.
Beam-Shields are arm weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Scintimures or maximal missile type Seidrs.

Bionis (Japanese: , Kyoshin, lit. Giant God; English dub: ) is a titan in . It is the organic counterpart to the Mechonis, and home to the Homs, Nopon and High Entia amongst other forms of organic life. It was also home of the Giants in the past. Bionis is locked in an ancient feud with Mechonis.

Bind is a debuff in . It prevents the afflicted from moving, but the victim can still attack or use arts if they are in range of their target(s). Unlike Topple, Daze and Sleep, Bind can not be removed by help from party members. This can be a hindrance to any position-dependent tactics for Shulk, Riki, or Fiora. It can even leave characters completely unable to aid in battle if they are separated without any long range arts when Bind is inflicted on them. To prevent this, Bind Resist gems or Debuff Resist gems can be equipped. Bind can be inflicted on enemies either via gems or arts such as Melia's Shadow Stitch art or Riki's Roly-Poly art. They can then be safely attacked by using long dist

The Bionis' Leg (巨神脚, Kyoshin Ashi) is the second major explorable area and one of the biggest areas in . It is located on the right thigh of the Bionis. Here the party meets Sharla and Juju at the Refugee Camp for the first time, and also encounters the Faced Mechon Xord. This area is reached from Colony 9 - which is located on the Bionis' right calf - by going through Tephra Cave - which extends underneath the right knee. Colony 6 can be accessed through the Bask Cave Passage.

The Bionis' Interior (巨神胎内, Kyoshin Tainai) is one of many areas featured in . One can enter the Bionis' Interior from both Makna Forest and Satorl Marsh, eventually emerging at the other. At the end of the game (Chapter 17), the Bionis' Interior becomes accessible in its entirety and becomes filled with enemies and collectables.

Biscuits for a Grandson (Japanese: , Mago e no Kukkī) is a quest in . It can be received from Marcia near the shop in the Commercial District of Colony 9. After this and An Errand for the Heropon are completed, Zukazu may offer another quest, A Big Brother's Fight. If Fiora is in the active party, she will comment.

Berryjammy (Japanese: , Sutorojamu, Strawjam) is a Nopon in . She can be found in Frontier Village at Apex Lake. If invited to Colony 6 she can be found at night in an alley on the north side of the main street near Colony 6 Shop 4.

Bitter Kiwi (Japanese: , Bitā Kiwi) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, they are fruit whose undeniable bitterness changes to eventual deliciousness. Two are required for one route of Ingredients For A Brew.

Betty (Japanese: , Betti) is a Homs in . She can be found in Tranquil Square of the Residential District of Colony 9. Despite being married, she has deep infatuation with Kenny Rohan, to the point of hating her old friend Désirée for becoming close to Kenny as his pupil (if Désirée becomes a sculptor).

Black Styrenes (Japanese: , Kuro Suchirōru) are collectables in . They can be found in the Central Factory and later in Colony 6. According to their description, they are writhing balls of black hair and are not very agreeable objects at all. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased in the Time Attack place from the Nopon Archsage for 16,500 Noponstones.

The Bionis' Shoulder (Japanese: , Kyoshin hidarikata lit. Giant God's Left Shoulder) is an area in . It is located on the left shoulder of the Bionis, and cannot be visited in normal gameplay. This area is quite large and contains many details which would never have been visible in the cutscene. Its internal ID number places it between the Frontier Village and the Eryth Sea, suggesting that it was originally intended to connect those two areas. However, Tetsuya Takahashi has revealed in interviews that the Shoulder was built as a "test map for checking 'various movements and the feel of jumping and falling'" and was not developed with intent for use in the final game. The Bionis' Leg Collection is a portion of the Collectopaedia in .

Black Liver Beans (Japanese: , Kuromamerebā) are collectables in . They can be found in the Bionis' Interior. According to their description, they are strongly bitter and a skilled chef can turn them into a gourmet food. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In the , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 23,400 Noponstones.

Black Beetles (Japanese: , Kurometarukanabun) are collectables in . They can be found in the Ether Mine and later in Colony 6. According to their description, they have a sheen like black metal and kids love them because they look cool. Two are required for Colony 6 Reconstruction. In , they can be purchased in Time Attack place from the Nopon Archsage for 4,200 Noponstones.

Black Blossoms (Japanese: , Kurozakura, Black Cherry Blossom) are collectables in . They can be found in Sword Valley and Colony 6. According to their description, they are small, sharp black flowers that are widespread but not well liked.

Black Panels (Japanese: , Haipaneru Burakku) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Frontier Village. According to their description, Melia named them in a rush and they are odd black panels.

Black Frogs (Japanese: , Buraggaeru) are collectables in . They can be found in the Ether Mine and Colony 6. According to their description, they are darker than the darkest cave and they rarely move so they look like stones.

Black Nectar is a rare material in . They can be dropped by Skeeters in Tephra Cave or traded for in Colony 9. According to their description, they are a mind-blowingly sweet nectar that gets great support from nectar fans. Two are required for Education-Minded Suzanna.
The Bionis' Interior Collection is a portion of the Collectopaedia in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Black Chips (Japanese: , Burakku Chippu) are collectables in . They can be found in the Ether Mine and later Colony 6. According to their description, they are black chips with residual charge and their wiring is busted.

Black Kiwi (Japanese: , Burakku Kiwi) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 9. According to their description, they are tremendously bitter kiwi fruits with a tremendously addictive taste.

This quest will expire after the decision to move to Colony 6. ※ After this quest is completed, Satata may offer another quest. See The Greedy Monster. Being a Good Grandfather (Japanese: , Sofu no Kokoro Mago Shirazu) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Satata in the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg. As with all the quests in the Refugee Camp, it will expire after the residents migrate back to Colony 6. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment.

Bitter Broccoli (Japanese: , Bitā Burokkorī) are collectables in . They can be found at night in Sword Valley and Colony 6. According to their description, they stay bitter no matter how they are cooked and they look like ordinary broccoli.

Black Irises (Japanese: , Ikisu) are collectables in . They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, their stems have hidden thorns that can injure anything that touches them. Four are required for A Place to Come Home to.

The Bird Necklace is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is an item required for Search Quest 1 on Bionis' Leg, a quest acquired from a female refugee in the Refugee Camp. To get it the party must go all the way through Kisk Cave, the cave just outside of the Refugee Camp on the right. At the other end is an elevated patch of land where there are several Tirkins. On the right there is a red light, the necklace. If the quest has been accepted, the item will appear as a red exclamation mark on the mini map.
Blaze Plus (Japanese: , En'netsu Kyōka) is a Gem in Xenoblade Chronicles that increases the amount of damage dealt when Blaze is inflicted upon an enemy. __TOC__
Blade Gear (Japanese: , Bureido Gia) is light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Bikini Bottoms are light legs armour in . They can only be worn by female party members. They can only be acquired at the Ether Light Shop in Colony 9.
Blade Leggings are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Beech Bangles are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be purchased at the shop at the Nopon Merchant Camp in Satorl Marsh, for 4,200 G.
Blade Gauntlets are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Bikini Tops are light torso armour in . They can only be worn by female party members, and have the same appearance as the Diver set of armour. They can be bought at the Ether Light Shop in Colony 9, or be traded for with Neonik after she immigrates to Colony 6.
Blade Armour is light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be dropped by various enemies and can be traded for with Vronik.

Believer's Paradise (Japanese: , Sūhai-sha no Rakuen) is a Secret Area in . It is located on the upper level of Bionis' Leg. It is on a platform overlooking the area, and is accessed through a lengthy cave passage east of the Zax Guidepost. It is north of Kasharpa Falls; however, the falls cannot be seen from the platform. During clear weather, it is inhabited by Flash Wisps at night and Clowd Fliers during the day. During rainy weather, Aqua Nebulae appear instead. The party must go to this Secret Area during the second part of the quest With Even More Gratitude, given by Gerugu at Traveller's Rest, to find the Ether Wisdom item. The Heart-to-Heart "Geography Lesson", between Dunban and Shu
Black-Steel Strikers (Japanese: , Kurogane no Tachi) are weapons in . They are swords wielded by Dunban.
Black Snipers (Japanese: , Burakkusunaipu) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are rifles wielded by Sharla. One can be obtained as a quest reward.

The Black Wreckage (Japanese: , Kuro no Zangai) is a landmark in . It is located on the lower level of the Fallen Arm. It is near Digit 5 Beach. It marks the final resting place of Metal Face and its pilot, Mumkhar, after their final confrontation with the party in Sword Valley. There is a Heart-to-Heart - "Eternal Scars" - between Melia and Dunban nearby.

Birthday Shoes (Japanese: , Oyabaka no Kutsu, Doting Parent's Shoes) is a quest in . It can be received from Kantz north of the Military District of Colony 9. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Believing Again (Japanese: , Mou Ichido, Shinjiru Kokoro wo) is a Timed Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Vidian southwest of the Imperial Palace in Alcamoth. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment. Building Bridges must be completed to trigger this quest.

Bizarre Ragoel (Japanese: , Ryōki no Ragoeru) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Rhana family, and can be found at level 88 on top of the lower cape at Anu Shore in Eryth Sea. It can drop the Thick Rhana Hides needed for A Token of Friendship.

This quest will expire after the events at the Meyneth Shrine. Best Boots (Japanese: , Ai no Būtsu) is a Timed Quest in . It is received by Bozatrox at the Machina Refuge in Mechonis Field after finishing the To My Loved One... quest. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment.

Bitter Wisp Fluids are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be traded for with various NPCs, or dropped by Colony Wisps at night, which are found near the Watchpoint Junction in Colony 6. According to their description, they are considered a fiercely bitter health food that might appeal to a gourmet. Five lots of Bitter Wisp Fluid are needed for A Tormented Bug-Lover.
Bind Resist (Japanese: , Baindo Teikō) is a Gem in that grants a chance to resist Bind effect. __TOC__
Blaze Defence (Japanese: , En'netsu Bōgyo) is a Gem in that reduces the amount of damage taken from Blaze. __TOC__
Blaze Attack (Japanese: , En'netsu Tsuigeki) is a Gem in Xenoblade Chronicles that is grants a chance to deal extra Blaze damage with a successful auto-attack. __TOC__
The Bionite Order (English dub: ) is a religious order in Xenoblade Chronicles. It was born within the culture of the High Entia. Its members worship Bionis and are notoriously zealous.

Bitey Bitey (Japanese: , Kamukamu damo) is one of Riki's physical arts in . It inflicts Bleed for 10 seconds, dealing an additional 20% of the initial damage every 2 seconds. If this art is used from the enemy's rear, the Bleed duration is increased to 20 seconds.

Black Flamiis (Japanese: , Burukku Furamī, Brook Flamii) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Flamii family, and can be found at level 12 near pools of water in Gaur Plain on Bionis' Leg. They can drop the Fertile Flamii Eggs needed for Material Quest 1.

The Beautiful Portrait is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is given to the party by Matryona if the Lake Drop is used instead of Nasty Weed during Matryona's Answer. The portrait is to be given to Ewan.

Behave (Japanese: , Ochitsuke mo) is one of Riki's Ether debuff arts in . It inflicts Paralysis on the enemy, and has a 75% chance of removing a Crazed aura from the enemy. The chance of removing Crazed is reduced when Riki's Tension is low. Behave is the only art whose advanced art book cannot be obtained prior to the events at Mechonis Core.
Bedtime (Japanese: , Guruguru damo) is one of Riki's Ether status art in . When used, Riki and all enemies in range may be put to Sleep.

Benevolent Aim (Japanese: , Hakuai no Aimu) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a level 51 Mechon, and can be found in Sword Valley, at the Monado Wound secret area behind six smaller Mechon units (two M63 Harvester Units, two M54 Armoured Units and two M82 Melee Units).

Black Smoke Hox (Japanese: , Kokuen no Hoggusu) are quest exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Hox family, and can be found on Raguel Bridge on the Bionis' Leg only during the quests To Colony 6! and The Road Home. Defeating them is required to complete either quest.

Beautiful Vagul (Japanese: , Baika no Vagūru, Plum Flower Vagul) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon, and can be found at level 60 in the Central Factory in the Storage Depot. It is advised to lure it away from the Mechon accompanying it. The party must defeat the Beautiful Vagul to complete the Eliminate the Backup! Surprise Quest.
This page is a list of all the Unique Monsters on Bionis' Leg.

Betty's Gift (Japanese: , Betti no Okurimono) is a quest in . It can be received from Betty in the floral area at Tranquil Square in the Residential District of Colony 9. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment. This quest and Désirée's Apology are mutually exclusive. The outcome of Désirée's Future determines which of these two quests will be offered. Once Désirée's Future (A route) is completed, this quest becomes available after Betty talks about Désirée joining the Defence Force with a green affinity established between them by speaking to Betty between 6:00 and 9:00, or between 12:00 and 15:00, or at 15:00 when leaving: :

Betrothal Test (Japanese: , Kon'yaku no Shiren) is a quest in . It can be received from Peppino in Colony 6 after completing Family Secrets involving En Argentis. This quest is mutually exclusive with Betrothal Test involving Zel Argentis. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment. Stopping the Elopement can be triggered after completing this quest.
This page is a list of all the Unique Monsters in Bionis' Interior.

The Blast Furnace Conduit (Japanese: , Yōkōro Kanritsūro) is a location in . It is a long corridor located at the southernmost point of the first basement floor of Galahad Fortress, and leads out to the Piston Control Room.

Bionis Ether are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from Asha Telethia near Colony 6. Bionis Ether are otherwise unavailable. According to their description, they are extremely pure Ether originating from the Bionis.

Black Vang Fangs are rare materials in . They can be obtained from Drunk Vangs and the Dark Kisling in the Ether Mine. Black Vang Fangs are also available for trade with Emmy Leater during A Young Captain's Trust and Perrine if she has moved to Colony 6 over Mefimefi. According to their description, they are completely decayed and no dentist in the world could fix them.

Black Queen Fibres are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from the Eternal Palsadia, the Dazzling Tolosnia, or the Firework Geldesia, and are not available for trade. According to their description, they are rare threads of black gold that make the wearer look more grown up.

The Biahno Hills (Japanese: , Biāno Kyūryō) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, northeast of Biahno Lake, east of Biahno Grassland, and northwest of Talon Rock Second Terrane. Several ruins, including the Plundered Ruin, can be found here.

Biahno Lake (Japanese: , Biāno-ko) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, west of New Los Angeles. The Biahno Hills and Biahno Grassland can be found north of the lake. Biahno River drains into this lake. Headwater Cavern is under the waterfall. After completing Water Woes, the Biahno Water-Purification Plant is built here.

Blast Fencer is a Class featured in . This class provides bonuses to melee attack and ranged attack. It is one of two classes that can be leveled up from Enforcer and can be leveled up to Galactic Knight. The class's standard weapons consist of Psycho Launchers and Photon Saber. Both Doug and Yelv use an Alternative Blast Fencer class.
Black Bane is one of Celica's two Signature Arts in . It is a Melee Art. Cross learns this art after completing the Affinity Mission New in New LA.

Beneath O'rrh Sim Keep (Japanese: , O-Ra-Shīmu Tenshu-ka) is a Scenic Viewpoint in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on the lower level of Cauldros, southeast of FN Site 505 and northeast of FN Site 506. As with all Scenic Viewpoints, its discovery yields an achievement ("Venturing Beneath O'rrh Sim Keep").

Black tar is a track in , composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano, with lyrics and vocals by mpi and David Whitaker. It is track one of disc two of the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack. This music is heard whenever the party engages an enemy in battle. In-game, it is split into two parts. The first part is played during ground combat and the second part is played during Skell combat. In , this song does not play during battles in Volitaris, with 2D-BATTLE playing instead. This song also appears in Tetris 99 as part of the theme, where Part 1 plays when there are between 99 and 51 players remaining, and Part 2 plays when there are between 50 and 11 players remaining.

Biahno Grassland (Japanese: , Biāno Sōgen) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, northeast of Biahno Lake, south of Unicorn Rock, southeast of Biahno River, and west of Biahno Hills.

The Big Arch (Japanese: , Biggu Āchi) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, atop a large natural arch structure. The FN Site 305 is located here, as are several ruins, mechanical Treasure Boxes and a large number of Ganglion troops. The entrance to the Milligan Supply Base is also here.

Biahno River (Japanese: , Biāno-gawa) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, with the headwaters east of the Green Threshold. The river flows to the southwest, and drains into Biahno Lake. It is the western border of Biahno Grassland, and on the east side of FN Site 103. The river is only considered discovered if the party has traveled to its headwaters.
Behold the Cranjelly is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District and the primary destination is Primordia.

Bismuth Xe-doms (Japanese: , Bisumasu Ze-raa) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Xe-dom machines, and can be found at level 51-92 in Sylvalum. They can be found patrolling various places at level 55, such as the Needle Rock Sandsea and Hilal Meadow. One can be found dormant at level 53 at North Silent Sandsea, while another patrols Anvil Sandplain at level 92. This particular Xe-dom is escorted by a pair of Titanium Oc-servs and is the strongest normal minor enemy in the game.

Blazing Lophids (Japanese: , Bureizu Rofiru) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Lophid family, and can be found at level 25-29 at White Phosphor Lake in Cauldros. Five of them must be defeating during Laying Lophids Low. They can drop the Alluring Lophid Extract needed for The Next Big Thing.
Blast Lophids (Japanese: , Burasuto Rofiru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Lophid family, and can be found at level 46-48 in Cauldros near FN Site 506.

Bernat is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found outside of the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles during the day. He can be found in the Central Industrial District of New Los Angeles during the night.

The Bizarre Insidia (Japanese: , Parako Bizārī) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Insidia family, and can be found at level 22 at Primordia's Headwater Cavern during The Ties That Bind when the party is looking for Tatsu's Dadapon's Sunglasses, but is not present in the morning. The mission does not require it to be defeated.

Berserk Vigents (Japanese: , Ranpēji Pekkā) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vigent family, and can be found at level 48 or level 50 at Keegan Ridge and Leaning Ring in Oblivia during the day.
Belenguer, the Gunhammer (Japanese: , Gekitetsu no Berengeru) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Ictus family. It can be found at level 30 near King's Falls in Oblivia.

The Bident Crossing (Japanese: , Nisōbashi) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a natural bridge structure located in Noctilum, crossing Middle Hushflood north of Everwhelm Falls. Its east end connects to the Great Trident Crossing.
Berry is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found in the northeast part of the Commercial District in New Los Angeles during the day along with Kaisis.
Bihabba (Japanese: , Bihaba) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Deck of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

Bismuth Oc-servs (Japanese: , Bisumasu Me-Tsuu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found at level 51 at FN Site 404 near the Badr Stronghold in Sylvalum. They are dormant until approached.

Blackback Bridge (Japanese: , Kokusen-bashi) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an artificial bridge located in Noctilum, spanning the Bloodpond Basin. It is southeast of the Lotus Keep Building Site and guarded by a single Puge, however there are more Puges and Quos in the surrounding area.

Blast Chards (Japanese: , Banban Akaza) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in the Central Ibra Ravine north of FN Site 318. Five are needed for the Normal Mission Professor B's Return.
Beats is an NPC in and . He can be found near North Founders Street in the Commercial District in New Los Angeles at nighttime. He is a member of the Mediators Division.
Berzerker Units (Japanese: , Bāsākā Yunitto) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum.

Belzadozebu Scallions (Japanese: , Beruzadozebu Negi) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular on the White Phosphor Lake. Two are needed for The Voltant Void.
Black Blatta Wings are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Blattas in Primordia.

The Biahno Water-Purification Plant (Japanese: , Biāno Jōsuijō) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia near Biahno Lake. This landmark is created after completing the Normal Mission Water Woes.

Big Forfexes (Japanese: , Biggu Pagurusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Forfex family, and can be found at level 35-38 near Beasts' Lair in Primordia during rainy weather.
Better Latte Than Never (Japanese: , Hakaima Barisuta, Destruction Demon Barista) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Jo near Barista Court in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Black Steel Heavy Armors are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vasara in Sylvalum.
The Bedrock Hold Approach (Japanese: , Ganban Yōsai-mae no Heigen) is an area in . It is located in Primordia, between the Bedrock Hold and the Lesser Gemini Bridge.

Bestial Utopia (Japanese: , Kemono no Rakuen) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a cavern in Cauldros, and can be entered from a large ledge on the north side of Mount M'gando, halfway between the water and the peak. Senirapa Water can be found here during Circle of Life.

Behemoth, the Netherdweller (Japanese: , Shin'en no Behemotto) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Virago family. It can be found at level 60 at Abyss Reservoir in Sylvalum, rarely replacing the Nether Virago that normally spawns there.

Blaudolch, the Chalcedony (Japanese: , Ōzui no Buraodoruhi) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Progen family. It can be found at level 20 at Seabird's Beak in Sylvalum. Though it can be found at any time of day, its appearances are rare, and a White Progen may be found in its place. Defeating it is required for the completion of Squad Task No. 12.

Bertrand, the Gorge Scourge (Japanese: , Yūkoku no Berutoran) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Adsecula family. It can be found at level 57 at East Ibra Ravine in Oblivia, hidden on the left wall in the grotto infested with Carmine Germivores.

Berthold, the Blue-Eyed (Japanese: , Hekigan no Berutohoruto) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Aeviter family. It can be found dormant at level 75 at Sandsprint Cavity in Sylvalum. It is accompanied by a pair of Macabre Aeviters.

The Berserker Marnuck (Japanese: , Kyōsenshi Marunāku) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Marnuck Ganglion member, notable for being much taller than most Marnucks and a more golden color. It can be found at level 45 at the O'rrh Sim Castle Ruins in Cauldros.

Blast Auravises (Japanese: , Burasuto Akuira) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Auravis family, and can be found at level 31-40 on the Leaning Ring in Oblivia. They can drop Auravis Croaking Bags necessary for the mission The Stick.
Black Blattas (Japanese: , Burakku Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 31-41 in Primordia's Rock Cavern.
Blazing Auto is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Samurai Gunner at rank 7.

Beryl Aetrygon Horns are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the horns of brown Aetrygons in Oblivia. One is needed for From Idea to Inventory. They are also used to craft Ranged Attack Boost and Boost.R-ATK augments.
Beryllium Oc-servs (Japanese: , Beriu Me-Tsuu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found at level 41-50 in Cauldros's Kw'arah Cloister.
Black Thallus Antennae are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black Thalluses in Noctilum.
Beauty Sleep is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Psycorruptor at rank 2.
Black Puffs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Mephites.
Black Turba Nectar is a common material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from blue Turbas.
Black Sylooth Braces are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from brown Sylooth in Oblivia.

Bio Visigels (Japanese: , Baio Narukī) are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Visigel family, and can be found at level 20 near the M'gando Gorge in Cauldros. Four waves of them must be defeated during Going Viral; they consist of one, two, four then six enemies. Ten must be defeated during Ovah and Out.
Binder is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is triggered when a character's Skell binds an enemy.

The Bewitched Glaive: Receding Rust is a melee weapon in . It is a level 60 Longsword that is dropped by the Tyrant Lugalbanda, the Wanderer-King, which appears after completing Chapter 12. In the original Wii U version of the game, this Longsword was also obtainable through Treasure Deal, allowing to obtain it before Lugalbanda has appeared, but that has been unavailable since the shutdown of Wii U online gameplay servers, and the no longer includes the Treasure Deal game mechanic. This weapon can have the following traits: * Arts: Recover HP XV * Critical Chance Up XV * Crush: Gain TP XV * Front Attack Plus XV * Melee Accuracy Boost XV * Melee Accuracy Up XV * Melee: Thermal Res Down XV *

Black Petramand Silk is a rare material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Petramands that have purple acid sacs or glowing orange acid sacs and limbs. Two are needed for The Next Big Thing.
Black Lifehold (Japanese: , Kuro no Raifupointo) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Milly at the Dorian Caravan in Oblivia.
Black Filiavent Tentacles are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black Filiavents in Cauldros' White Phosphor Lake.
Blazing Gas Sacs are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtain from Sphinxes. They are needed to craft Potential Up augments of rank X or better.
Big Balaena Sand Bags are unique materials in . They can be obtained from Balaenas in Primordia or Oblivia that have yellow gas sacs.
Black Colubrim Tails are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Elvira, the Talondrake.
Blatta Splatter is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Curators and the primary destination is Cauldros.
